newsitem.title: FINLAND: LANNEN T. TO COMBINE UNITS, SEES SYNERGIES.
newsitem.headline: LANNEN T. TO COMBINE UNITS, SEES SYNERGIES.

text.p: Finnish foodstuffs group Lannen Tehtaat Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would centralise freezing of vegetable food products to the plant in Sakyla, seeking annual synergy benefits of 10 million markka.
"Lannen Tehtaat estimates to reach annual synergy benefits of 10 million markka through combining the operations," it said.
"The benefits will materialise partly in 1997 and fully in 1998," it added.

The centralisation follows the merger with Tresko Foods which has a frozen foods production unit in Turku. This unit would become Lannen Tehtaat's packaging and storage unit in Turku and also to continue producing some frozen goods, Lannen Tehtaat said.
